Feature to render the callback URL for the new "When an incoming Teams Webhook request is received". The Power Automate Integrations team is adding this integration with Teams as a new trigger. This trigger is functionally identical to the "When an HTTP request is received" trigger, except it does not let the user set the request schema, method, or relative path. The request schema is hardcoded to be the input of an array of adaptive cards for use in later actions. Because the user is intended to post a request to the callback URL of the designer to trigger the logic app, we need to render the callback URL in the v3 designer, similar to how it is rendered for the "When an HTTP request is received" trigger. We have already added the new trigger kind in LogicApps-RP: [Add Teams Webhook Kind](https://msazure.visualstudio.com/One/_git/AzureUX-BPM/pullrequest/9218000) - **What is the current behavior?** (You can also link to an open issue here) Callback URL does not render for new trigger kind on logic apps save - **What is the new behavior (if this is a feature change)?** Callback URL renders for Teams Webhook trigger kind - **Does this PR introduce a breaking change?** (What changes might users need to make in their application due to this PR?) body:
Method `absence_in` complements existing `presence_in` and can be used to check for absence on the blacklist .

<!--
Thanks for contributing to Rails!

Please do not make *Draft* pull requests, as they still send
notifications to everyone watching the Rails repo.

Create a pull request when it is ready for review and feedback
from the Rails team :).

If your pull request affects documentation or any non-code
changes, guidelines for those changes are [available
here](https://edgeguides.rubyonrails.org/contributing_to_ruby_on_rails.html#contributing-to-the-rails-documentation)

About this template

The following template aims to help contributors write a good description for their pull requests.
We'd like you to provide a description of the changes in your pull request (i.e. bugs fixed or features added), motivation behind the changes, and complete the checklist below before opening a pull request.

Feel free to discard it if you need to (e.g. when you just fix a typo). -->

### Motivation / Background

<!--
Describe why this Pull Request needs to be merged. What bug have you fixed? What feature have you added? Why is it important?
If you are fixing a specific issue, include "Fixes #ISSUE" (replace with the issue number, remove the quotes) and the issue will be linked to this PR.
-->

Existing method `Object#presence_in` can be used for whilelisting:

```ruby
def page_title
  params[:page_title].presence_in(%w[photos videos]) || "photos"
end
```

However, sometimes sometimes it is important to check for absence on the blacklist rather than whilelist inclusion:

```ruby
def page_title
  params[:page_title].absence_in(%w[default hidden]) || "photos"
end
```

Seems like this method does not add any additional complexity. I also wasn't able to come up with a clean, short and good-looking alternative based on existing methods (tell me if I'm missing something!).
  
### Detail

This PR adds implementation for `Object#absence_in` ActiveSupport core extension.

author: danny-avila
body:
## Summary
I integrated Azure OpenAI support for both DALL-E-3 and DALL-E-2, necessitating updates to environment variables and documentation to reflect the changes in how the DALL-E API keys are managed.

- Updated environment variables to support version-specific credentials for DALL-E-3 and DALL-E-2, with placeholders such as `DALLEx_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, `DALLEx_AZURE_API_VERSION`, `DALLEx_BASEURL`, and `DALLEx_API_KEY` where 'x' is replaced with `3` or `2` depending on the version.
- Modified the documentation to explain the new environment variables and how to set them up for Azure OpenAI support.
- Documented the breaking change concerning user-provided `DALLE_API_KEY` which now requires separate keys for each version of DALL-E.
- Informed users that the admin-provided `DALLE_API_KEY` in the `.env` file will work for both versions, while individual users will need to provide their API keys again if it's not set.
- Recommended that users uninstall and reinstall the plugin if they encounter issues due to the updated API key requirements.

Closes #1449

 Before you open the request please review the following guidelines and tips to help it be more easily integrated:

 - Describe the scope of your change - i.e. what the change does.

 Thank you for contributing! We will try to test and integrate the change as soon as we can, but be aware we have many GitHub repositories to manage and can't immediately respond to every request. There is no need to bump or check in on a pull request (it will clutter the discussion of the request).

 Also don't be worried if the request is closed or not integrated sometimes the priorities of Bitnami might not match the priorities of the pull request. Don't fret, the open source community thrives on forks and GitHub makes it easy to keep your changes in a forked repo.
 -->

### Description of the change

PR #54817 added `DB_REPLICATION_SLAVE_DUMP` in [bitnami/mariadb/10.10/debian-11/rootfs/opt/bitnami/scripts/libmariadb.sh](https://github.com/bitnami/containers/pull/54817/files#diff-f0d409bb0b40d9ad9ee21460e8ac7b3cc3012abafef0aeb9c5401d18c1aab61bR241) causes error when starting mariadb replication in docker-compose. 
```
mariadb 22:48:02.48 INFO  ==> Configuring replication in slave node
/opt/bitnami/scripts/libmariadb.sh: line 241: DB_REPLICATION_SLAVE_DUMP: unbound variable
```
This PR adds `DB_REPLICATION_SLAVE_DUMP` in `mariadb-env.sh` for 10.10, similar as how other versions are doing (i.e. 10.11 [mariadb-env.sh](https://github.com/bitnami/containers/blob/main/bitnami/mariadb/10.11/debian-11/rootfs/opt/bitnami/scripts/mariadb-env.sh#L137-L138))

Fixed mariadb 10.10 replication startup error.
